query:
UPDATE recipe
        SET
            name           = COALESCE($1, name),
            active         = COALESCE($2, active),
            price_per_meal = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $3::float8::numeric ELSE price_per_meal END
        WHERE id = $5
        RETURNING
            id                       AS "id!: Uuid",
            name                     AS "name!",
            active                   AS "active!",
            created_at               AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
            price_per_meal::float8   AS "price_per_meal?: f64"
